title: Loop+ Membership Refund and Cancellation Settings by Plan
content:
Refunds desk schedule of the plan settings that govern Loop+ Membership cancellations and fee refunds. Each setting is stated for all six plans.

## Full refund settings

| Plan | Full refund window after a paid charge (calendar days) | Benefit uses allowed since the charge for a full refund | Benefit codes that count as a use |
|---|---|---|---|
| Loop+ Access Monthly | 3 | 0 | free shipping, Two-Day delivery, Same-Day delivery, video streaming, music streaming, grocery delivery |
| Loop+ Student Monthly | 3 | 0 | free shipping, Two-Day delivery, Same-Day delivery, video streaming, music streaming, grocery delivery |
| Loop+ Student Annual | 3 | 0 | free shipping, Two-Day delivery, Same-Day delivery, video streaming, music streaming, grocery delivery |
| Loop+ Monthly | 3 | 0 | free shipping, Two-Day delivery, Same-Day delivery, video streaming, music streaming, grocery delivery |
| Loop+ Annual | 3 | 0 | free shipping, Two-Day delivery, Same-Day delivery, video streaming, music streaming, grocery delivery |
| Loop+ Household Annual | 3 | 0 | free shipping, Two-Day delivery, Same-Day delivery, video streaming, music streaming, grocery delivery |

## Prorated refund, effective date and destination

| Plan | Prorated refund outside the full-refund conditions | How a prorated refund is sized | Smallest prorated refund paid (USD) | When a cancellation takes effect unless the buyer ends immediately | Where membership refunds are sent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Loop+ Access Monthly | no | not applicable | not applicable | end of the paid period | original payment method |
| Loop+ Student Monthly | no | not applicable | not applicable | end of the paid period | original payment method |
| Loop+ Student Annual | yes | unused whole months | 5.00 | end of the paid period | original payment method |
| Loop+ Monthly | no | not applicable | not applicable | end of the paid period | original payment method |
| Loop+ Annual | yes | unused whole months | 5.00 | end of the paid period | original payment method |
| Loop+ Household Annual | yes | unused whole months | 5.00 | end of the paid period | original payment method |

## Definitions

- **Full refund window**: the calendar days after a paid charge within which an immediate cancellation with no benefit use is refunded in full, a whole number; 3 on every plan.
- **Full refund maximum benefit uses**: the benefit uses allowed since the charge for a full refund to apply, a whole number; 0 on every plan.
- **Benefit uses counted**: the benefit codes that count as a use for refund purposes. On every plan these are free shipping, Two-Day delivery, Same-Day delivery, video streaming, music streaming and grocery delivery.
- **Prorated refund (shown in the plan settings as the annual partial refund)**: whether an immediate cancellation outside the full-refund conditions earns a prorated refund; yes on Loop+ Student Annual, Loop+ Annual and Loop+ Household Annual, no on the three monthly plans.
- **Partial refund basis**: how a prorated refund is sized; unused whole months on the plans with a prorated refund, not applicable without partial refunds.
- **Partial refund minimum**: the smallest prorated refund paid, in USD; 5.00 on the plans with a prorated refund, not applicable without partial refunds.
- **Default cancellation effect**: when a cancellation takes effect unless the buyer ends immediately; the end of the paid period on every plan.
- **Refund destination**: where membership refunds are sent; the original payment method on every plan.

## Notes

- The prorated refund setting divides the family along billing cycle lines: every annual plan carries it and no monthly plan does.
